comparability.scope: Configuration receipts establish the declared changes; they do not prove arbitrary custom policy code equivalence.

diagnostic_thresholds.gap_definition: Maximum successive emitted-token host-return gap; excludes arrival-to-first-token.
diagnostic_thresholds.scope: Historical diagnostic only, not a business or final-paper SLO. The 4s limit may not bind.

direction: All changes are right minus left; lower timing is better.

config.scope: Native math scale development cell; all requests retained; quality analyzed separately; no held-out claim.

pressure_peak.scope: Schedule/allocation boundaries only; not unseen internal peaks.

resolved_runtime.scope: Observed runtime geometry, not a pressure verdict.

schedule_wrapper_wall.definition: Instrumented scheduler wrapper wall time; includes native scheduler and observer, not isolated observer overhead or process CPU.

limitations: All planned requests remain in the comparison, including wrong answers, truncations and failures.
Historical TTFT20s/max-host-gap4s thresholds are diagnostic, not a final paper or business SLO.
Different generated outputs confound a pure scheduling speed comparison; identical-output sensitivity is a selected subset.
Single finite bursts do not establish repeatability or a causal policy benefit.
Gate coverage can overlap. Scheduler wrapper time cannot isolate observer overhead.
